verdict.rationale: The evidence shows feedback collection, voting, AI-assisted surfacing of impactful opportunities, and user-attribute segmentation for release notes. None of it documents customer context, such as account attributes or revenue, shown alongside feedback for prioritization. User attributes are documented only for targeting release notes, which is an adjacent feature and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access customer context alongside feedback so I prioritize what really matters
